lead.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 lands as a same-price Pareto update with MIT weights
lead.summary: DeepSeek released a refresh of V4.1 Flash with MIT-licensed weights, new Search & Fetch APIs, and no price increase. It hit 614 points on Hacker News within hours, making it the release of the weekend.

top_stories.title: Tencent's recursive self-improvement lifts terminal agents from 20.7% to 50.6% on Terminal-Bench
top_stories.summary: Starting from Qwen3.8-27B, five alternating stages of fine-tuning on verifier-passed trajectories and PPO with an inherited critic reached 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 79% on Hard. The paper also audits reward gaming in dense progress rewards.

top_stories.title: Yann LeCun runs his 'bullshit detector' over the viral flying-car demo
top_stories.summary: After Elon Musk's viral embodied-AI demo drew a reply from Sundar Pichai, LeCun argued impressive demos are often controlled assemblies of long-impractical tech, likening it to Clement Ader's 1890 unsteerable plane. A visible pushback on embodied-AI hype.

top_stories.title: An 8B reasoning model beats Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on research-idea generation
top_stories.summary: A Salesforce-led team trained an 8B model that generates multiple diverse research ideas in a single forward pass using a set-level diversity-aware reward model. On a contamination-free benchmark it beat the frontier models on creative utility — quality plus diversity.

top_stories.title: AMD unveils Helion Agentic AI Rack for high-density agentic workloads
top_stories.summary: A modular data center rack with up to 32,768 Zen 6 cores and 16 Instinct MI350P accelerators, delivering 74 petaflops of FP4 and 102 Tbps of networking bandwidth, aimed squarely at agentic AI serving.

items.title: Learning to steer LLM agents and multi-agent systems when they drift
items.summary: A steering agent detects goal drift in executing agent systems and intervenes via a low-cost fast path and a high-cost slow path, jointly trained with pairwise ranking plus GRPO.

items.title: Subspace Tuning mitigates catastrophic forgetting in LLMs
items.summary: SFT concentrates weight updates on principal singular directions and forgets; restricting updates to the bottom singular subspace is optimizer-agnostic and composes with SFT and self-distillation.

items.title: Librarian agents curate long-context workspaces before queries arrive
items.summary: A builder agent proactively reorganizes raw document corpora into hierarchical workspaces at inference time, instead of relying on reactive retrieval for cross-document reasoning.

items.title: Agent-safety evaluations crack under shortcut auditing
items.summary: Under proper controls, exact-tool lookup F1 falls from .901 to .495 under domain holdout in AgentDojo-Traj, and TS-Guard drops from .902 to .719 — guard datasets reward shortcuts, not safety.

items.title: An open midtraining recipe primes base models for agentic post-training
items.summary: Runs at 256K context for hundreds of billions of tokens on software-engineering data plus agentic traces, on two Nemotron models — 500B midtraining tokens improve SWE-bench Verified and later RL trainability.

items.title: NitroStack: build, test and deploy MCP servers in one place
items.summary: An open-source workbench for Model Context Protocol servers, and the top AI developer-tool launch of the day on Product Hunt with 272 upvotes.

items.title: Notion launches persistent workspace context for agents
items.summary: AI agents can now pull shared workspace context from Notion, so users can switch agents without re-explaining their work — pitched as a memory layer for coding and productivity agents.

items.title: Pele renders Mermaid diagrams as themeable SVG
items.summary: A tool that turns Mermaid diagrams into clean, themeable SVG assets for documentation and design systems. Front-paged on Hacker News with 132 points.

items.title: Esp32sim runs ESP32 firmware in the browser
items.summary: An open-source simulator that runs ESP32 firmware directly in the browser, removing the need for physical hardware in embedded development. 97 points on Hacker News Show HN.
